text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While watching Kawakami Princess's
training
footage in my room, I consider
my options
carefully.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
How should I have her run in her debut
race... or
rather, in all her races from this
point on?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The footage comes from another
scrimmage I
entered her in recently.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Hmm? Huh? Aghhh?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In practice, she has no trouble coming
out of the
gate, and her form is
impeccable.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But as soon as she's faced with an actual
"race,"
even if it's only a scrimmage,
everything seems to
fall apart.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her whole body suddenly seizes up like
a machine that hasn't been oiled. She
puts all her strength into each step, but
it only makes her movements heavy. And
I think I know the reason why...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: She's overexerting herself.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Wah?! I'm very sorry. I called out to you,
and you
said I could come in, so...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I must have been so absorbed in
watching the
footage that I replied to
Tazuna without realizing
it.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
It's okay. I can understand why you'd be

concerned seeing Kawakami Princess in
that
state.
choice_data_list: I should be the one apologizing.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
That kind of overexertion puts a lot of
strain on
the body. She could hurt
herself like that.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And injuries aren't the only thing I'm
worried
about.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's still a bit tense, and ends up
building up a lot of tension in her
shoulders. If she keeps
running with this
stiff form...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's highly likely that tendency will
become a
habit.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
If you enter her into a big race as she is
right now,
it's only going to make her
even more tense.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
For Kawakami Princess, just the notion
of
entering a big race might seem like
realizing a
long-awaited dream.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, it's far too early for her to set
her sights
on the big stage. I have to
think about her future.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day has come for Kawakami Princess
to make
her debut.
choice_data_list: (If I really want what's best for ...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Let's gooo! I'm all warmed up and
bursting with
energy! I'm going to get
out there and run rings
around everyone!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I have to become super strong—just like
Princess
Fighter!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
At the very least, during my junior year,
I want to
run in the Hanshin Juvenile
Fillies, and then blast
down the G1 path!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To Kawakami Princess, G1 races must
represent everything she
seeks—challenges where she can face
the ultimate rivals and become like her
ideal, Princess Fighter.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And many of those G1 races can only be
entered
during the junior and classic
years.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Trainer, it's time for a
strategy
meeting! I'll carry out any plan
you come up with!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She looks at me, her eyes beaming with

anticipation. But what I'm about to tell
her will
likely betray her hopes.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh, I'm glad that you're so forward
thinking,
too, Trainer! Please continue!
choice_data_list: There's something I'd like to disc...
There's something I want to talk a...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her starry eyes pierce through my core.
But since
I'm the person who must help
shoulder her
dream...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Future... Gulp. Then you mean...
choice_data_list: I was just thinking about our "fut...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If I want her to have a healthy career, I
have to
tell her this clearly.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?
choice_data_list: I really don't want to aim for a G...
I don't want to aim for a G1 right...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: You... you don't? Then, um, that means...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
You don't think I have the potential to
become a
G1 Umamusume?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I tell her about the problems she
currently exhibits while running and
explain that we should gain more
experience before shooting for G1
titles.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I won't rule out entering G1 races
entirely, but setting them as our
objective would overburden
her with the
pressure to win.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ...I see. Yes, you're right.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I understand!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
The Tiara is the princess's crown,
obtainable only
from the grandest of
stages—the G1 races.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
And I always envisioned myself competing
fiercely in the Tiara tour,
awakening my potential
on the field of
battle just like Princess Fighter.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
But at the end of the day, I am my own
person!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I may look up to Princess Fighter, but my
true
goal is to become my own ideal
princess!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
So if you think it's for my benefit,
Trainer, then I'll
happily start with any
objective, no matter how
small.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Yes. So keep a good eye on me from the
stands.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Today, I'm taking my first step on the
road to
becoming a princess.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Okay!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: (I'm actually so relieved, Trainer.)

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
(You're different from anyone I met
when I was a child. I can just sense that
you have what it takes
to become the
Legendary Trainer.)

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
(You truly believe from the bottom of
your heart
that I can be my ideal
princess!)
